_note: docs/strategy.md, Steel - Emrys Rooke. A stage-damage beatdown; since the 2026-09-29 revision the list is almost all Strikes and blocks, with the situational one-offs cut. Few attacks deal printed wounds (Steel Lashing Tail +4, Steel Scalebound Blow +2, Steel Rending Talon 2 on a hit, Steel Clawed Heel 3 for a life card), so `damage_stage` (2.0) sits above `damage_life` (1.2): stages past the target's Energy overflow into wounds one for one, and the floor pushes every Strike past that buffer. The floor is 3 The Long Year at +1 on every attack for the rest of the game and 3 Steel Clawed Hands Drill at +2 on Strikes until the next climb discards them. Subtheme one, Energy swing: Steel Scaled Forearm, Steel Serpentine Twist and Steel Swallowed Flame strip 3 or 4 Energy while they stop the attack, and Steel Ironscale Hide stops any attack and refills 7, which also moves both Might bands, hence `foe.energy` and `foe.band` high. Subtheme two, board removal: Steel Horn Gore, Marble Seal 4 and the Aspect 3 power take permanents off, so `effect.discard_in_play` and the `foe` permanent weights are up. Subtheme three, card flow, nearly all of it on entering_combat (the Mastery, Mourne's Quickness Drill, Foresight, Aspects 1 and 2), which is why `declare_bias` stays high. Fervor is a by-product of attack cards it would play anyway (Steel Horned Charge, Steel Lashing Tail, the Emrys Strikes): `fervor_self` prices our own gain low while `effect.fervor` stays high for the critical-damage option, because policing their climb is the plan. 22 blocks, several of which strip Energy, refill it or let it repeat the stopped attack (Caedan's Riposte), so `defend_card` is well above the old 0.9.
